summary: For changing infrastructure from clouds, LDAP, Cobbler or CMDBs, use dynamic inventory via plugins (recommended) or scripts (still supported via the script plugin). AWX and Ansible Platform offer a GUI inventory database synced to these sources.
questions: How do I manage inventory for cloud hosts that come and go?
Should I use inventory plugins or inventory scripts?
Can I still use old inventory scripts?
Is there a GUI for dynamic inventory?

answer_card.title: Dynamic inventory overview
answer_card.answer_md:
When hosts change constantly or come from multiple sources (cloud, LDAP, Cobbler, CMDB), use dynamic inventory.
- **Inventory plugins**: recommended; use the latest core features; you can write your own.
- **Inventory scripts**: still work, via the backward-compatible script plugin.

For a GUI, AWX or Ansible Automation Platform sync all your sources into an inventory database with web/REST access and per-host failure history.
